{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values after conversion
invalid_after_conversion = sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Print the number of rows where revenue could not be converted
print('Number of rows with invalid revenue after conversion:', invalid_after_conversion)"}
